title: Razemki
description: Razemki is a community server for the Sympatycy Razem discord guild.
body:
![Razemki text](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9e6f224ad15e70388bbd9289924b97f3dfa2272d_0.webp)
# Welcome to Razemki
It's a unique and welcoming Minecraft community created with the main goal of bringing players together! Our server is firmly focused on cooperative gameplay, deep integration among players, and building a truly positive, friendly atmosphere where everyone can feel at home. Whether you want to build amazing structures, explore the blocky world with new friends, or just relax and chat after a long day, Razemki.pl provides a stable and highly enjoyable environment for all.

Join us today to become part of a growing, tight-knit community that heavily values teamwork, creativity, and mutual respect.
We cannot wait to see you in the game and build something amazing together!
